Class PiratesCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.AdventureCard
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.Enemy
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.PiratesCard
public class PiratesCard extends Enemy
PiratesCard represents an enemy card within the game, extending the base functionality of the Enemy class. This card introduces the challenge of battling pirates, handling cannonades, and rewarding the player upon victory or penalizing them upon defeat. The card includes properties such as credits earned, days lost upon defeat, and the ability to handle complex multi-player battle scenarios. Additionally, it manages a sequence of effects that players encounter during the battle phase.

  • Constructor Details

    • PiratesCard

      public PiratesCard(GameBoard gameBoard, String description, int level, String name, int dayslost, int minimumFirePower, int creditsEarned, List<CardEffect> listEffects)
      Constructs a PiratesCard object, representing an enemy card with specific attributes and effects. This card interacts with the game board and represents a challenge to players utilizing its effects and properties.
      Parameters:
      gameBoard - The game board instance where the PiratesCard is used.
      description - A description of the PiratesCard, detailing its effects or specifics.
      level - The level of the PiratesCard, indicating its difficulty or strength.
      name - The name of the PiratesCard.
      dayslost - The number of days lost when encountering this card.
      minimumFirePower - The minimum firepower required to overcome this card.
      creditsEarned - The credits awarded to players upon overcoming the card.
      listEffects - A list of effects that this PiratesCard applies during the game.
